title: Picture analysis disables optional reasoning while preserving labels and provider compatibility
steps: Run quiet picture analysis wire tests with fake provider responses.
expect: Provider-specific reasoning controls and bounded outputs reach label and observation requests.
A provider rejecting the optional reasoning field is retried once with the same cancellation signal and output bound.
Unrelated refusals are not retried by the compatibility fallback.
An unrelated provider refusal retains its readable response body for the caller.
fence: Quiet request fields only; current p6 risk labels, image coverage and cache key remain intact.

tests: photo labels: a provider that refuses the field is asked once more without it
photo labels: a 400 about something else is not asked again
quiet fallback preserves cancellation and output bounds without retrying an unrelated refusal
photo observations retry a refused quiet field once and retain their output bound
an unrelated provider refusal keeps its readable body and request boundaries
